page.overview:
Who is Hyo Imawano?

Hyo Imawano (忌野 雹 Imawano Hyō) is a fighting game character in the 3D fighting game series Rival Schools.

Hyo has long silver hair tied in a high ponytail and black eyes. He wears a long red traditional military uniform with black outlines, a matching folded sleeves, a white armband on his left arm, golden straps at the center of the uniform, red military pants with a black belt to his waist and black boots. He also wears white gloves and his katana.

As Demon Hyo in Project Justice, Hyo is shirtless, his skin is pale, his hair is loose and his eyes are glowing red, making him completely resemble his late-father. He wields two katanas, one of which has a broken blade with spiritual abilities.

Hyo is shown to be a calm, smart, and serious person much like his twin brother Kyosuke. Aside from this, he is also a master manipulator with a militaristic attitude and that he had planned to reform and take over not only Japan, but the entire world by force. He is also able to brainwash people into following him with much ease due to his past ninja training. Although Hyo had considered the concepts of both love and friendship as being "completely mundane and meaningless" when it comes to his lifestyle, he is able to understand and acknowledge the true power that the two of them have, especially after he was defeated by Kyosuke and his friends during the events of Rival Schools: United by Fate.
